label: Introduced the paradigm shift model to explain discontinuous revolutionary ruptures in scientific history
Defined normal science as cumulative puzzle-solving conducted within an unchallenged paradigm
Articulated semantic and taxonomic incommensurability between successive scientific paradigms
Kuhn's historicist critique of cumulative science and paradigm shifts paralleled and informed Foucault's archaeology of epistemes
Kuhn's demonstration of science as a communicative community grounded in consensus paradigms informed Habermas's theory of communicative rationality
